description: Base image, Python dependencies and the release workflow's actions. Updates only reach users with the next release (AGENTS.md): merging a Renovate PR doesn't publish anything.

packageRules.description: Base image carries a digest; digest PRs bring base-OS fixes
Stay on Python 3.12 until a deliberate upgrade (chromadb and the other deps must support the new version)
Major version bumps need a tick on the Dependency Dashboard first
